name: daya-variety-store
description: Phase 3 local admin and multilingual static storefront

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:storefront && npm run dev --workspace @daya/storefront
scripts.check: npm run prepare:storefront && npm run typegen --workspace @daya/storefront && tsc --noEmit -p apps/storefront/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json && node --import tsx --test tests/catalogue.test.ts tests/phase2.test.ts tests/admin.test.ts && node --test tests/init.test.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run prepare:storefront && npm run build --workspace @daya/storefront && node --import tsx scripts/verify-export.mjs
scripts.catalogue:export: node scripts/init-demo.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/admin-cli.mts export
scripts.prepare:storefront: node scripts/init-demo.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/admin-cli.mts prepare
